_comment: Cross-repo bridge edges for the 14-repo Kiotel graph. Every edge below is grounded in a verified file+line finding from the 15-agent deep-read (see docs/kiotel-estate.html). Both endpoints are real AST file-nodes. These are what join the estate's repos into one queryable component. Applied by scripts/apply-graph-repairs.py after every rebuild. relation semantics: calls=runtime HTTP/socket/DB call; references=config/token/contract reference; shares_data_with=same DB/bucket.

bridges._evidence: kiosk.external.ts builds ${base}/api/v1/external${path} with Bearer KIOSK_API_TOKEN; externalApiAuth.ts is the server-side validator
space Kiosk Transaction module reads /transaction-reports/:id/audit under scope read:transaction-reports
admin-client.ts calls admin.kiotel.co /v1/auth/* and /v1/service/*; kiotel-admin is the IdP that owns the RBAC constants
kiotel-admin is the HMAC client of the lox admin API (KIOTEL-HMAC-SHA256 signing in adminapi/auth.go)
extension OAuth2 PKCE at ${dashboardBase}/oauth/authorize -> POST /api/v1/ext/oauth/token, served by extOAuth.ts
audit.py posts the audit result to POST /api/v1/internal/ai-audit (upserts session_ai_audit), gated by X-Internal-Secret in internal.ts
recording.ts is the platform control plane that starts/stops recordings on the audio service with a recording JWT + X-Internal-Secret
the kiosk holds the Socket.IO connection; processCommand consumes RELAY commands emitted by ws/messages.ts, and emits telemetry back
chatbot NL->SQL reads the same 'kiosk' Postgres kiotel_web owns (t_sessions, id_scanjobs, session_ai_audit and sensitive tables) read-only
chatbot's trained schema includes session_ai_audit, which audio_services writes - it can query AI-audit results
kiosk streams call audio directly to audio_services over WebSocket: buildIngestUrl() -> s.ingestUrl + '/ws/ingest', HMAC-per-frame; ws_combined.py is the ingest handler
portal posts housekeeping tasks to ${API_BASE2}api/v1/external/tasks - pushed to kiosk devices via kiotel_web
kiotel-admin fetches ${base}/api/v1/external/devices with a Bearer partner token - admin IS a partner-API consumer of the kiosk platform (revises the 'two isolated clusters' picture)
kiotel-admin tells Kiotel Space (space.kiotel.co/api/service/identity/revoke) that a user lost access; identity.controller.ts is the space-side revocation handler
